newsitem.title: USA: Mercantile to acquire Arkansas bank.
newsitem.headline: Mercantile to acquire Arkansas bank.

text.p: Mercantile Bancorp Inc said Thursday it will acquire Horizon Bancorp Inc, a $551 million bank holding company in Arkadelphia, Arkansas, for 1.7 million shares of Mercantile common stock.
The acquisition will increase Mercantile's market share in the state of Arkansas to total assets of more than $1.8 billion, Mercantile, a $30 billion asset bank holding company said.
The deal is the latest in the acquisition trail for Mercantile, which earlier this year acquired St. Louis-based Mark Twain Bancshares Inc and Roosevelt Financial Group Inc.
In conjunction with the transaction, Mercantile may purchase up to 170,000 shares of its own common stock in the open market, the company said.
The merger is subject to the approval of Horizon Bancorp shareholders and all appropriate regulatory authorities, and is expected to close in the first quarter of 1998, the company said.
Mercantile shares were down 3/16 at 70-5/8 Thursday.
